verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for an API platform like Replicate, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a Replicate command-line interface. The only related item is Cog, described as an open-source tool for packaging and deploying custom models, which is not shown to be a CLI for running or managing Replicate workflows. The probes show only llms.txt and docs.md (Node.js and Colab guides) and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
